caption: The drawing features four distinct objects rendered with fine, pale lines and subtle color. At the center, slightly to the top, there is a detailed straw bonnet with light blue ribbon decorations tied in a bow at the side; the structure of the bonnet is emphasized with parallel curved lines suggesting woven material. Beneath this, a second view of the same bonnet is shown from the back, highlighting the concentric structure and the large blue ribbon bow at the nape. In the upper left corner, there is a rectangular piece of fabric with a scalloped bottom edge, decorated with small embroidered floral motifs and outlined with delicate lines. In the lower left corner, another rectangular piece is depicted, filled with a solid light blue color at the center and narrow sections of parallel lines at both ends, indicating either fabric or ribbon. The background is uncolored parchment or light beige paper with no additional embellishments.
title: Bonnet
